answer: What I would defend is proof of unique land registry title deed with land registry office attestation, because the landowner's signed record is the one cost that scales against the attacker. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 110 POA and 15 minutes each, 80190 POA and 10935 minutes in all. Weigh the meadow against the claim, weigh the mesa against the reward, and weigh the ridge against the farm's story: the scales tip the same way every time. A hundred aliases, a hundred proofs, a hundred bills: the farm gives up first.
